executive_summary: Twenty consecutive weeks of absolute zero trades executed. The Supply & Demand Zone strategy is structurally dead — it has not generated a single trade in approximately 5 months across all market regimes. The min_score threshold of 75, combined with restrictive zone formation parameters, makes it mathematically impossible for signals to pass filters. This is no longer a tuning problem; the entire strategy entry mechanism must be replaced or fundamentally rebuilt from scratch.
target_progress: 0% — 70% below 70% target. No trades means no progress is possible.
regime_assessment: Regime detection is irrelevant when zero trades are generated. The market has been trending_up for 7 consecutive days — a regime that should be highly favorable for demand zone bounces — yet zero signals were produced. Regime detection cannot be evaluated without trade data, but it is clearly not informing strategy selection in any useful way.

symbol_changes.remove_reason: No symbol-level data exists because zero trades have been taken in 20 weeks. Cannot make data-driven removal decisions.
symbol_changes.focus_reason: No winning symbols to focus on. The first priority is generating ANY trades at all.

dow_pattern: No day-of-week pattern can be identified — zero trades across all weekdays for 20 consecutive weeks. Day-of-week analysis is meaningless without trade data.

param_search_adjustments.reasoning: After 20 weeks of zero trades, the parameter space must be radically opened. Min_score has been 75 for months with zero signals passing — drop to 30-55 range to force signal generation. RR ratio of 2.0 eliminates trades where zones are close to price; lowering to 1.0-1.8 allows realistic entries. The immediate goal is generating trades to collect performance data, not optimizing already-nonexistent returns. We can tighten parameters AFTER we confirm the strategy can produce signals at all.

structural_recommendations.change: EMERGENCY: Replace Supply & Demand Zone as the primary strategy with a simpler momentum/breakout strategy that is proven to generate signals in trending_up regimes. Keep S&D Zone as a secondary confirmation layer only.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Move from 0 trades/week to 5-15 trades/week. Even at 45% win rate, this produces actionable data and potential positive P&L with proper risk management.

structural_recommendations.change: Implement a 'strategy circuit breaker' rule: if any strategy produces zero trades for 2 consecutive weeks, automatically switch to a fallback strategy (e.g., EMA crossover with ATR-based stops, or VWAP mean reversion).
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Prevents future 20-week dead periods. Maximum downtime reduced from infinite to 2 weeks. Ensures the bot is always actively learning from live market data.

structural_recommendations.change: Add a diagnostic logging layer that records WHY zones are being rejected — is it zone quality score, RR ratio filter, base candle count, or zone staleness? Without this, we are blind-tuning parameters.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Identifies the exact filter bottleneck within 1-2 days instead of guessing for months. Enables targeted parameter adjustment rather than wholesale changes.

structural_recommendations.change: Decouple zone identification from trade entry. The bot should log all identified zones (even those not traded) with their scores, so we can backtest filter thresholds offline without waiting weeks for live results.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Enables offline parameter optimization. Could compress 20 weeks of dead iteration into 1-2 days of backtesting. Identifies whether the problem is zone detection or zone filtering.

structural_recommendations.change: Implement a multi-strategy rotation framework: maintain 2-3 active strategies scored by recent performance, allocate capital proportionally. This eliminates single-strategy dependency.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Diversifies signal generation across strategies. Even if one strategy goes cold, others maintain trade flow. Expected to sustain 3-10 trades/week minimum across all conditions.

primary_strategy_next_week: Momentum Breakout (replace S&D Zones as primary; S&D Zones demoted to secondary confirmation)
